scope: Generic permanent source-copy from exact linked exile creature with base stat exception and a retained immutable activation; completes engine support for Mimeoplasm after the entry-exile cluster. No ordinary card definitions/admissions.

oracle.name: Mimeoplasm, Revered One
oracle.oracle_text:
As Mimeoplasm enters, exile up to X creature cards from your graveyard. It enters with three +1/+1 counters on it for each creature card exiled this way.
{2}: Mimeoplasm becomes a copy of target creature card exiled with it, except it's 0/0 and has this ability.

semantics: The active recipe owns the immutable activated definition/index. It does not rebind a current copied card slot and is itself copiable under707.9a.
The activation uses the normal activation payment, target, stack and funding pipeline. Shared activation_mana_costs evaluates its exact immutable definition and real source.

Original linked ability acquisition identity is captured on the stack and carried across this ability's own permanent copies. Another copier or a later unrelated copy acquires a fresh origin and no previous linked cards.

The exile target binds its link origin when announced. A later copy does not rebind that independent stack ability, while a stale target incarnation fails normally. A departed source never rebinds a later object.
The base0/0 exception is copiable, counters stay independent, and the self-bound copy survives cleanup. Layer-six removal suppresses the retained ability; control changes preserve its exact links.
Craft/ability predicates recognize the retained real activation. Lifecycle currently admits nonmana battlefield templates without once-per-turn/exhaust history.

representation.cold_state: One optional origin per existing copy layer; existing owned rows and recipes
representation.frozen_view_cost: CopyRecipe/CopyExceptions and CopyLayerView gain optional typed data; exact sizes printed by first focused test for root benchmark notes.
